extDescription: Save, search, and copy API keys, tokens, and code snippets locally in your browser — without digging through .env files.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Follow the operating system or choose a fixed theme.

language.title: Language
language.description: Choose the language used by SnippetVault surfaces.

analytics.title: Anonymous usage data
analytics.description: Help improve SnippetVault by sharing how often its two search entry points are opened. This is off by default.
analytics.details: When enabled, SnippetVault reports only when you open the side panel or open in-page search with double Shift. Searches and all other product actions are never reported.
analytics.permissionDenied: Google Analytics access was not granted. Anonymous usage data remains off.
analytics.saveFailed: Could not update the anonymous usage data setting.

workspace.contextDescription: Combine a name and color to identify a project, provider, or environment.
workspace.contextSnapshotNotice: Saved snippets follow the current context name and color. Hiding a context only removes it from future choices.
workspace.defaultDescription: Choose how many days a new temporary item remains available.
workspace.newItemsOnly: The default days apply to new temporary items and quick extend. Existing items are not updated in bulk.
workspace.invalid: Enter a whole number of at least 1 day.
workspace.saveFailed: Could not save the default expiry.

taxonomy.archiveNotice: Hiding a label only removes it from future choices. Existing snippets keep their saved label.

storage.localDescription: Snippet content and metadata stay in this extension's local IndexedDB.
storage.backupDescription: Export or import a readable JSON backup. The file contains snippet contents, secrets, full URLs, and source metadata.
storage.importReplaceWarning: Importing this backup fully replaces saved labels, contexts, vault items, and temporary workspace items.
storage.importPreferencesUnaffected: Your SnippetVault UI preferences are not changed.
storage.backupImportedIndexPending: The data was replaced successfully. Search will rebuild from the imported data.
storage.backupConflict: Local data changed after the preview. Preview the backup again before replacing it.
storage.backupTooLarge: That backup file is too large.
storage.backupFailed: Could not complete the backup action.
storage.noticeTitle: Local data and backups are readable
storage.noticeDescription: Anyone with access to this browser profile or an exported .sv file can read snippet content, secrets, URLs, and source metadata. Keep backup files private.

errors.internal: Something went wrong. Please try again.

errors.expiryFuture: The expiry must be in the future.

errors.unsupportedBackup: This backup version is not supported.
errors.invalidBackup: This is not a valid SnippetVault backup.
errors.invalidResponse: The extension returned an unrecognized response.
errors.noResponse: The extension is not responding. Please try again.

create.workspaceLabelsHint: Optional. Choose labels when they make this temporary item easier to retrieve.
create.noLabels: No labels are available yet. You can still save without one.

edit.vaultDescription: Update this record without changing its type or captured source.
edit.workspaceDescription: Update this temporary record and, if needed, its expiry.
edit.labelsHintWithArchived: Archived labels already on this snippet can be kept or removed; other archived labels are unavailable.
edit.archivedLabel: $1 is archived and remains available only on this snippet.
edit.expiryHint: Leave this unchanged to preserve the current expiry.
edit.expiryInvalid: Choose a future date and time.
edit.conflictDescription: Refresh the results, reopen the snippet, and apply your changes again.
